accounting_scope: Release physical totals count the original operation handle rows, including distinct per-operation instances when descriptor/inode values recur. Unreturned lower-reader handles and observer duplicates retain their separate partition/conditional counts. Selected primary domain entries exclude the strong-reader counterexample; operation counts include it and the original/baseline cohorts. TAP assertions are retained original execution evidence, not new fixture executions.

claim_legs.durability: Tracked exact source pins, original rows, first failures, the counter-review result, corrected proofs and final copied outputs support saved-only revalidation. Book and Knowledge Map commands route to that verifier; task acceptance and source-sensitive doctrines gate the commit.
claim_legs.falsify: Original closure, missing/duplicate cases, changed outcomes and historical identities, false recovery attribution and unsafe roots reject. The original counter rejects valid pre-envelope rows; its correction rejects invented envelopes and erased errors. Original close observations distinguish all closes from injected failures, and altered report/handle accounting rejects.
claim_legs.rederive: One Git-bound current inventory authenticates original source epochs and prospective/corrected pins. Unchanged original contract/domain/row/state oracles and independent physical counters rederive the complete selected release domain, native lifetimes, distinct outcomes and exact allocation absence.

scope: Complete the declared finite inactive release qualification from original retained evidence. Keep symbolic effects, original release, healthy boundaries, independent call/readback/absence faults, selected close reports/compositions and representative genuine omissions distinct. Conditional lower-reader composition does not assert every-site reachability. Combined lifetimes, compatibility, native authentication/transport, actual OS close failures, arbitrary-writer atomicity and historical startup/parent/full CI/push remain separate gates.
verification: Final saved-only join and recovery, rendered-book inspection, Knowledge Map, task integrity and claim checks pass. Staged doctrines and normal commit hooks remain the commit gate; full CI/push remain historically gated.
